definitions.explanation: The basic structure or frame that supports something, such as a building, ship, or conceptual plan.
The basic framework or outline of a plan, story, or concept.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{骨組|ほねぐ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}した→完成する：25528_kanseisuru⟧。
examples.english: The framework of the building has been completed.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧ (bone) + {組|く}み (assembly). Refers to the essential supporting structure — both literally (buildings, ships) and figuratively (plans, stories).

LITERAL USE:
- ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{骨組|ほねぐ}み (building framework)
- ⟦{鉄骨|てっこつ}→鉄骨：24552_tekkotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{骨組|ほねぐ}み (steel frame structure)
- {骨組|ほねぐ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{組|く}み{上|あ}がる (the frame is assembled)

- ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{骨組|ほねぐ}み (outline of a thesis)

- ⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{骨組|ほねぐ}み (basic structure of a story)
